commands.title: Roost: Go to the Claude Tab

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Roost
walkthroughs.description: Claude and Codex tabs, Teams, Jira and Confluence, and your pull requests, in one place.

steps.title: Talk to Claude
steps.description:
Your first Claude tab is open beside this page: type a message there. Codex tabs work the same way.
[Go to the Claude Tab](command:roost.goToClaude)

steps.title: Search your code (optional)
steps.description:
Give Claude and Codex tabs a tool that searches the workspace, by keywords and, once installed, by meaning. Off unless you turn it on.
[Turn On Codebase Search](command:roost.codebaseSearchOn)
[Not Now](command:roost.codebaseSearchNotNow)

steps.title: Sign in to Teams
steps.description:
Read and answer your Teams chats without leaving the editor.
[Sign In to Teams](command:chirp.signIn)

steps.title: Connect Jira and Confluence
steps.description:
Set your Atlassian site, then sign in.
[Set Site URL](command:jay.siteUrl)
[Sign In to Jira](command:jay.signIn)

steps.title: Sign in to GitHub
steps.description:
The PRs tab shows the PRs waiting on you, using the GitHub CLI's sign-in.
[Sign In to GitHub](command:roost.githubSignIn)

steps.title: Choose your parts
steps.description:
Switch off any part you don't use; the rest carries on.
[Open Roost Settings](command:roost.openSettings)
